senses.gloss: --the son of माध्रि's son, युधाजित्; had two sons श्वफल्क and Citraka. वा. ९६. १०१.
(I)--the wife of सविता, and mother of शावित्री, व्याहृती and others. भा. VI. १८. 1.

(II)--देवकी in the epoch of स्वायम्भुव Manu: Married Sutapas the progenitor: was engag- ed in तपस् with her husband for १२००० divine years. To them was born Hari by name पृश्निगर्भ. भा. X. 3. ३२-41; 6. २५.
--a manifestation of Hari born of पृश्नि and Sutapas during the श्वायम्भुव epoch. भा. X. 3. ४१.
--a class of gods doing श्राद्ध. Br. III. १०. १०९; वा. ७३. ६१.
--a god of Sumedhasa group. Br. II. ३६. ५९.
--Indra of the XI epoch of Manu. Vi. III. 2. ३०. [page२-389+ ३४]
--the last son of Somaka अजमीढ and father of Drupada. भा. IX. २२. 2; वा. ९९. १९२; Vi. IV. १९. ७३.

(I)--A son of विरूप, and father of Rathi- tara;
1: भा. IX. 6. 1; Br. III. ६३. 6; वा. ८८. 6; Vi. IV. 2. 8-9.
a मन्त्रकृत्.
2: M. १४५. १०३.

(II)--the son of पृथु and father of आन्ध्र;
1: वा. ८८. २६.
a मन्त्रकृत् and of the Angirasa branch.
2: Ib. ६९. १००.
(III)--the son of अनरण्य and father of हर्यश्व. Vi. IV. 3. १८.
--a mixture of ghee and curds as a sacrificial offering. Br. IV. 1. ९८; वा. १००. १०३.

(I)--a son of Vaivasvata Manu. Being appointed by his teacher to be in charge of cattle he attend- ed to it zealously. During nights he kept awake in वीरासन posture. On a dark rainy night a tiger entered the stall and caught hold of a cow, when the other cows ran pell-mell. At this the prince drew the sword, and in the darkness he cut off the head of a cow and the ear of the tiger. Next morning he reported the sad news to the preceptor, who cursed him to become a शूद्र. He however continued to live a life of celibacy, and detachment to things mundane, ever con- templating on Hari. He reached ब्रह्मा by entering the forest-fire in the course of his wanderings. भा. VIII. १३. 3; IX. 1. १२; 2. 3-१४; Br. III. ६०. 3; M. ११. ४१; १२. २५; वा. ६४. ३०; ८६. 1; Vi. III. 1. ३४; IV. 1. 7, १७. [page२-390+ २८]

(II)--a son of स्वायम्भुव Manu;
1: Br. II. ३८. ३१; वा. ८५. 4; ८६. 1.
killed his preceptor Cyavana's cow and was cursed to become a शूद्र.
2: Br. III. ६१. 1.
--one of the seven seers of the स्वारोचिष epoch. Vi. III. 1. ११.
--one of the ten branches of the सुकर्माण clan of Devas. Br. IV. 1. ८८; वा. १००. ९२.
--a daughter of मरीचि and सम्भूति. वा. २८. 9.
